headline: COP, SCOP and HSPF: What Heat Pump Efficiency Ratings Actually Mean
subheading: COP, SCOP and HSPF are the numbers that tell you how efficient a heat pump really is. Here's what each one measures, how to read them on a spec sheet, and how to convert between them.
seoTitle: COP vs SCOP vs HSPF: Heat Pump Efficiency Ratings Explained
description: What do COP, SCOP and HSPF mean for a heat pump? How each efficiency rating works, how to read a spec sheet, and how to convert HSPF to SCOP.
